info.name: GDL Fintech V2 API
info.description:
Full API documentation for GDL Fintech V2 API Gateway. Base URL: https://stagingapi.gdl.com.ng

Authentication: Most endpoints require a Bearer token in the Authorization header.
Set the `base_url`, `user_token`, and `admin_token` collection variables before use.
